visualCharacteristics: Full-width light band near the foot of the page with a centered heading, a short supporting paragraph, and a single solid brand-blue button.
contentPattern: Row 1: heading text. Row 2: paragraph text. Row 3: a hyperlink whose link text is the button label and whose URL is the button target.
usage: Closing call to action at the bottom of provider pages (e.g. contact or sign-up prompts).
